name: Autonomous Bug Hunter & Fixer
description: Continuously monitors the platform for errors, exceptions, and anomalies. Automatically diagnoses root causes and applies fixes with AI-generated patches.

steps.description: Gather recent errors from application logs and Sentry
Use AI to categorize errors by severity and root cause
steps.prompt_template:
Analyze these errors from DoctaRx telehealth platform. Categorize by: CRITICAL (data loss/security), HIGH (user-facing broken), MEDIUM (degraded experience), LOW (cosmetic/log noise). For each, identify root cause and affected files:

{{errors}}

steps.description: Trace error through codebase to find exact fix location
Generate a targeted fix for the identified bug
Validate the fix doesn't break existing functionality
Apply the validated fix with backup

null_reference.fix_strategy: Add null checks and optional chaining

unhandled_promise.fix_strategy: Add try/catch wrapper and error propagation

db_connection.fix_strategy: Add connection retry logic with exponential backoff

auth_bypass.fix_strategy: Verify auth middleware chain and token refresh

memory_leak.fix_strategy: Identify unbounded growth patterns, add cleanup handlers
